info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Lookup API enables users to retrieve information about external agencies based on specific parameters. This API is designed for financial service providers and banking institutions who require detailed supplier agreement data for external partners. By utilizing a unique identifier, clients can quickly fetch relevant agency details, facilitating seamless interactions and compliance checks. Typical consumers of this API include account managers, compliance officers, and integration systems looking to enhance their agency data retrieval processes.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific supplier agreement using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows users to access agreement information that may include terms, parties involved, and other relevant data.

requestBody.description: This request body should include the necessary details for retrieving supplier agreement information for the specified resource. Ensure that all required fields according to the schema are populated appropriately.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the supplier agreement details are returned.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Request.description: A JSON representation of the request body for the Operations GET request related to supplier agreements.

agreementId.description: Unique identifier for the supplier agreement.

bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) associated with the agreement.

countryCode.description: Country code where the institution is located.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the agreement becomes effective.

purchaseOrderId.description: Identifier for the associated purchase order.

categoryCode.description: Code indicating the category of the agreement.

approvalLevel.description: Level of approval required for the agreement.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the agreement record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the agreement was last updated.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for the supplier agreements retrieval operation showing details of an agreement including institution information and metadata.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for tracing the request.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata schema providing additional information regarding the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the API endpoint being accessed, useful for tracking and analytics.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the runtime application that processed the request, beneficial for debugging and monitoring.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication method. The client must pass a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header to access secure endpoints.
